a simple pseudonym changing scheme that does not require any explicit cooperation between a group of communicating vehicles or any infrastructure support can be implemented by refraining from transmitting heartbeat messages when the vehicle is moving at a slow speed, and by changing pseudonyms at the same time when such a silent period ends.

(1) a simple and effective pseudonym changing scheme is to refrain from transmitting heartbeat messages when the speed is below a given threshold and to change pseudonyms during each such silent interval; (2) the proposed scheme is effective in protecting location privacy of vehicles, but it does not seriously impact the safety of life.

a simple and practical solution for location privacy in vehicle communications systems can be obtained if vehicles refrain from sending heartbeat messages and changing pseudonyms when their speed drops to a given threshold.
